title: The account shell is not runnable
fault: The injection sets the account shell to /bin/false.
signature: an instant close with exit status 1 and no shell prompt
prompts: Did the failure sit in the auth, or after it?
What did the client print between the auth and the close?
hints: The auth succeeded, so the key and the account are fine.
The session starts a program and the program dies at once. Ask what the server runs as your session.
Compare the exit status of this login with the exit status of a working login.

reveal.wrong: The injection set the shell of the practice account to /bin/false, so the session runs a program that exits with status 1 the moment it starts.
reveal.fix: Set the account shell back with the chsh command or usermod -s /bin/bash practice, and log in again.
